cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: A vibrant coastal city known for its iconic Sydney Opera House, stunning Harbour Bridge, and world-class dining.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: Australia's cultural capital, celebrated for artistic laneways, vibrant cafe culture, live music, and lush botanical gardens.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: An electric metropolis seamlessly blending futuristic skyscrapers, tranquil Shinto shrines, and Michelin-starred dining.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: The historic heart of Japan, featuring thousands of classical Buddhist temples, bamboo groves, and traditional tea houses.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cities.description: Famed for its dramatic mountain backdrops, Copacabana and Ipanema beaches, and the towering Christ the Redeemer statue.

cities.name: São Paulo, Brazil
cities.description: A dynamic cultural megacity boasting world-renowned art museums, architectural landmarks, and cutting-edge culinary scenes.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: The largest religious monument in the world, renowned for its breathtaking Khmer architecture and sunrise reflections.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: An ivory-white marble mausoleum on the Yamuna river, recognized worldwide as a masterpiece of Mughal craftsmanship.

temples.name: Wat Rong Khun, Thailand
temples.description: Known as the White Temple, an extraordinary contemporary art exhibit in the style of a Buddhist temple in Chiang Rai.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: A South Pacific tropical paradise surrounded by turquoise lagoons, coral reefs, and luxury overwater bungalows.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: One of the most famous 4-kilometer crescent beaches in the world, bustling with seaside kiosks, sun, and soccer.

beaches.name: Grace Bay, Turks and Caicos
beaches.description: Consistently awarded as one of the planet's top beaches, featuring powdery white sand and shimmering turquoise waters.
